_comment: Mod management operations and UI strings - to be populated during migration

single.title: Update this mod?
single.intro: This mod is part of the following collections:
single.curator_version: These collections use a version selected by their curator.
single.caution: If the curator recommends this update, you can continue. Otherwise, updating may cause the collection to stop working as intended.
single.acknowledge: I understand that updating this mod may affect my collection.

batch.title: Update these mods?
batch.intro: Some of these mods are part of the following collections:
batch.curator_version: These collections use a version selected by their curator.
batch.caution: If the curator recommends these updates, you can continue. Otherwise, updating may cause the collections to stop working as intended.
batch.acknowledge: I understand that updating these mods may affect my collection.

manualInstaller.title: Choose install folder
manualInstaller.intro: Choose the folder inside the game directory to install {{modName}} into.
manualInstaller.noGameFolder: The game folder couldn't be found. You can still install to the game folder itself or to a new folder.
manualInstaller.gameFolderFailed: The game folder couldn't be read.
manualInstaller.folderNameEmpty: Enter a name for the folder.
manualInstaller.folderNameDot: A folder can't be named "." or "..".
manualInstaller.folderNameTrailingDot: A folder name can't end with a dot.
manualInstaller.folderNameInvalidCharacter: A folder name can't contain any of these characters: \ / : * ? " < > |
manualInstaller.folderNameTaken: A folder or file with this name already exists here.
manualInstaller.selectDirectory: Select a folder to install to, not a file.
manualInstaller.checking: Checking for files that would be replaced...
manualInstaller.statusIncomplete: Some of the game's files couldn't be checked, so a file that replaces another or conflicts with a mod may be shown as new.
manualInstaller.useAsDefault: Use this folder for future mods for this game
manualInstaller.useForAll: Use this folder for the remaining mod ({{count}} more)
manualInstaller.useForAll_plural: Use this folder for all remaining mods ({{count}} more)

sourceUnknown.title: Mod source unknown
sourceUnknown.body: Vortex doesn't know where this mod came from, so it can't check for updates.

notIdentified.title: Mod not identified
notIdentified.body: Vortex can't identify this mod, so some features, including checking for updates and adding it to Collections, won't work.

chooseFile.title: Choose update file
chooseFile.body: Vortex can't determine the correct update automatically.

rowActions.installDescription: Installs the mod into your game, where it can be enabled or disabled.

disableShared.title: Disable mods?
disableShared.caution: Disabling them may affect those collections. Keep the shared mods enabled to avoid issues.

deleteView.body: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This won't delete any mods, but the view and its customisations will be permanently removed.

viewName.createIntro: Give your view a name. It keeps the filters, sort, grouping and columns showing now, and saves any you change after.
viewName.renameIntro: Give your view a new name. Your columns, grouping and filters won't change.

properties.label: Properties
properties.noSelection: Select a mod to see its properties
properties.categoryHint: Change the category of this mod to help organise your mod list. This won't affect its category on the website.
properties.categoryHint_plural: Change the category of these mods to help organise your mod list. This won't affect their category on the website.
properties.notesHint: Add personal notes to this mod to help keep track of important information. These notes are only visible to you.
properties.notesHint_plural: Add personal notes to these mods to help keep track of important information. These notes are only visible to you.
properties.sourceHint: Where you got this mod. Vortex checks there for updates.
properties.sourceHint_plural: Where you got these mods. Vortex checks there for updates.
properties.websiteInvalid: Enter a full address, such as https://example.com
properties.modTypeHint: Decides where and how the mod is deployed. Leave it on Default unless you know the mod needs another.
properties.gameSectionHint: The game on Nexus Mods this mod came from. Only change it if you downloaded it from another game's section, so Vortex can find its updates.

editedView.resetHint: Discards your changes and returns this view to its defaults.
editedView.saveHint: Saves your current filters, sort, grouping and columns as a view you can return to.

modsDropTarget.title: Drop files to add mods
modsDropTarget.archives: Archives (.zip, .rar, .7z) are added as mods to your list.
modsDropTarget.files: Individual files and folders are packaged into mods before being added.
